clue.text: Aware that nothing is missing

definitions.meaning: someone alert and mentally sharp is said to have all their wits about them
a set with every piece present is complete, with nobody or nothing absent

explanation.surface: Someone checking a delivery is conscious that the full order has arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means mentally alert; read literally it says every part is present and complete.

clue.text: Purposeless schism in the current era

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks years of the present era
a rift is a split or schism

explanation.surface: An aimless split in modern society.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat floating without mooring or steering drifts aimlessly, so the word also means lacking direction.

clue.text: Fans see three hundred balls bowled

parts.note: three hundred balls make fifty six-ball overs, and fifty is the Roman numeral L
what is bowled in cricket comes in overs, sets of six deliveries

explanation.surface: Cricket fans watching a long innings of three hundred deliveries.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is six balls, so 300 balls bowled is fifty overs: L (Roman 50) and OVERS. 'see' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Devotees or enthusiasts of something are said to be keen admirers of it.

clue.text: Airfield affords cover to a deserter

indicators.note: the airfield piece covers or wraps the little word, holding it inside

parts.note: a runway is the strip at an airfield used for take-off and landing

explanation.surface: A fugitive soldier hides at an aerodrome.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who flees, such as an absconding soldier, has run off.

clue.text: They have faith and back America

parts.note: hind means rear or back, as in hind legs
US is the usual abbreviation for the United States

explanation.surface: Believers who also support the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers of the Hindu religion are believers, people with a religious faith.

clue.text: Suffering from catalepsy means disorder incarnate

indicators.note: disorder signals that the letters of incarnate are jumbled into new order

explanation.surface: A medical note: catalepsy is a physical illness made flesh.
explanation.definitionFit: Catalepsy is a seizure of rigidity and unresponsiveness, much like being in a stupor.

clue.text: Appropriate to your secret

parts.note: to appropriate is to take something for oneself, to steal it
thy is the old form of your

explanation.surface: Taking another's private information as one's own.
explanation.definitionFit: Furtive and covert action is done quietly so as not to be noticed.

clue.text: One animal worker in the circus is fascinating

indicators.note: the word in tells us the next pieces sit within the circus arena

parts.note: the ring is the arena where a circus performs
one is the Roman numeral I
a vet is someone who works treating animals

explanation.surface: A vet tending the circus animals in the big top makes a gripping spectacle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gripping holds the attention, as if it had been fastened in place.

clue.text: Custodial release that is granted by Scottish magistrate

parts.note: bail is the release of an accused person from custody pending trial
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A Scottish justice agrees to let a prisoner out on bail.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland a bailie is a municipal officer who sat as a local magistrate in burgh courts.

clue.text: A weird name for Lords and Ladies

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or strange

explanation.surface: An odd title given to members of the peerage.
explanation.definitionFit: Lords and Ladies is a folk name for the wild cuckoo-pint, a woodland plant of this genus.

clue.text: Artillery dismiss enemy captive with hesitation

parts.note: to fire someone is to dismiss them from a job
POW stands for prisoner of war
er is the sound of a speaker hesitating

explanation.surface: An order to sack an officer who hesitates over a captured enemy soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Guns and artillery collectively make up an army's capacity for destructive fire.

clue.text: Quintet comes in to dance and make merry

indicators.note: the quintet enters the dance word, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish folk dance
a quintet is five, the Roman numeral V

explanation.surface: Five musicians arrive to play for the dancing and the party gets going.
explanation.definitionFit: To celebrate boisterously is to have a lively, noisy good time.

clue.text: Couple always having to make entreaties

parts.note: pr is the abbreviation for pair, a couple
ay, or aye, is an old word for ever or always

explanation.surface: A married pair who are forever pleading.
explanation.definitionFit: To beseech or plead earnestly is to ask humbly, as in a prayer.

clue.text: Supplement horsepower?

definitions.meaning: to add to and strengthen something
punningly, the strength a rider uses through the leather strap to control a horse

explanation.surface: Extra strength for an engine rated in horsepower.
explanation.definitionFit: To bolster means to add support; split as a phrase it is the force applied through a horse's strap.

clue.text: He assumed power on entering military parade

indicators.note: the little word goes inside the parade word, as if walking into it

parts.note: a march is a formal procession of troops

explanation.surface: A general seizes control by marching his troops into the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A king or queen is a ruler who takes up sovereign power on accession.

clue.text: Commonplace title for Sir Robin's autobiography, maybe

definitions.meaning: routine and everyday, happening as each morning comes

definitions.text: title for Sir Robin's autobiography, maybe
definitions.meaning: Sir Robin Day was a famous British television interviewer; his surname suggests a punning title

explanation.surface: A dull, routine name for a broadcaster's memoirs.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes routine daily progress, and puns on the surname of interviewer Robin Day.

clue.text: Willing dispositions

parts.note: looks like cheerful temperaments, but means things disposed of by making a will

explanation.surface: Eager, cooperative temperaments.
explanation.definitionFit: Legacies are items given away under a will, so they are testamentary disposals of property.

clue.text: Useful service arranged any time

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of any time are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A handy facility available whenever you like.
explanation.definitionFit: A facility such as a pool or library is a convenience provided for users.

clue.text: Mournful cry from snowy owls

indicators.note: from signals that the letters are taken out of a run spanning the two words

explanation.surface: The plaintive call of Arctic birds of prey.
explanation.definitionFit: A howl or wail is a long loud cry of pain or grief.

clue.text: Source of cheap pork for Jingle's servant

definitions.meaning: a pig's foot, a cheap cut of meat
The servant of the rogue Alfred Jingle in Dickens's Pickwick Papers

explanation.surface: A Dickens character's manservant hunting for cheap meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pig's foot sold cheaply by butchers shares its name with Jingle's man Job in The Pickwick Papers.

clue.text: So one African country contains national from another

parts.note: Mali is a country in West Africa

explanation.surface: One African state harbours a citizen of a neighbouring one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contains' is a link: the clue plays on one country's name holding the nationality of another, Somalia, on the Horn of Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of Somalia comes from a second African country, distinct from Mali.

clue.text: Stock tax

definitions.meaning: a breed or line of descent, as of animals or plants
to put under pressure or stretch to the limit

explanation.surface: A levy on shares.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a breed or variety, and also to overtax something by heavy demands.

clue.text: Pretend to be hale and hearty

definitions.meaning: to feign or deceive, as in poker when holding a weak hand
describing someone frank, cheerful and robust in manner

explanation.surface: Faking good health and high spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means deceiving by pretence; as an adjective it means genial and blunt.

clue.text: Disconcert and discredit old leader of the party

parts.note: to wrong someone is to treat them unjustly and damage their name
Michael Foot led the British Labour Party from 1980 to 1983

explanation.surface: A political smear campaign against a former party chief.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch someone off balance, as a tennis player sending the ball the opposite way, is to unsettle them.

clue.text: Guarantees to talk about Greek earth goddess

indicators.note: about tells us the talk piece goes round the goddess

parts.note: gas is informal for idle talk or chatter
Ge, or Gaia, is the earth goddess of Greek myth

explanation.surface: Promises made in conversation about a deity of the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Pledges are deposits or securities given as assurance, an old sense of the word.

clue.text: Longing for father to go to Delaware

indicators.note: the father piece goes on after the state piece, joining it at the end

parts.note: DE is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Delaware
to sire is to father, and a sire is a father

explanation.surface: A dad yearning to travel to an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong wish or yearning is the feeling of wanting something.

clue.text: Magi resolved to follow saint thanks to manifest signs of his piety

indicators.note: the scrambled magi letters come after the saint abbreviation
resolved here means the letters of Magi are broken down and reworked

parts.note: ta is an informal British word for thank you

explanation.surface: The Magi follow a saint and give thanks for visible proof of his holiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Marks resembling Christ's crucifixion wounds are said to appear on the bodies of especially devout saints.

clue.text: They agree to send son into Aden country

indicators.note: into shows the son letter is placed within the country

parts.note: Aden is a port city in Yemen
s is the abbreviation for son, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Agreeing to post a boy out to the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: Sycophants say yes to everything their boss proposes, never disagreeing.

clue.text: East German given power by the Soviet

parts.note: p is the symbol for power in physics
a Soviet citizen was commonly called a Russian

explanation.surface: A Cold War East German strengthened by Moscow's backing.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the GDR; the answer is a native of Prussia, the historic kingdom in what was eastern Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Prussia was a German state lying largely in the east, so its people were eastern Germans.
